# contentful_team_space_membership (Resource)

Manages a Contentful Team Space Membership, assigning an existing team admin access or roles in a space.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "contentful_team_space_membership" "this" {
  space_id = var.contentful_space_id
  team_id  = var.team_id

  admin = false
  roles = [var.role_id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `admin` (Boolean) Whether the team has admin access in the space.
- `roles` (List of String) List of role IDs assigned to the team in the space.
- `space_id` (String) ID of the space. Changing this value replaces the resource.
- `team_id` (String) ID of the team. Changing this value replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite Terraform resource identifier in `space_id/team_space_membership_id` form.
- `team_space_membership_id` (String) System ID of the team space membership.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) Duration for the complete operation, including retries, for example `30s` or `5m`. Defaults to `2m`.
- `delete` (String) Includes retries and uses the duration saved in state (default `2m`, minimum provider timeout `10s`).
- `read` (String) Includes retries and uses the duration saved in state (default `2m`, minimum provider timeout `10s`).
- `update` (String) Duration for the complete operation, including retries, for example `30s` or `5m`. Defaults to `2m`.

## Import

### By identity (Terraform 1.12 or later)

```terraform
import {
  identity = {
    space_id                 = var.contentful_space_id
    team_space_membership_id = var.team_space_membership_id
  }
  to = contentful_team_space_membership.this
}
```

### By ID (Terraform 1.5 or later)

```terraform
import {
  id = "${var.contentful_space_id}/${var.team_space_membership_id}"
  to = contentful_team_space_membership.this
}
```

### From the command line

```shell
terraform import contentful_team_space_membership.this "$CONTENTFUL_SPACE_ID/$CONTENTFUL_TEAM_SPACE_MEMBERSHIP_ID"
```
